title: A magazine at the station
situation: You are {{Markus}}, following the trail to {{Jericho}} through a rail station at night. A magazine lies on a bench by the bins.

media.title: Tech Addict: Android Astronauts to Explore Io
facts: NASA has launched an all-android crew on a three-year journey to Io with no return planned; the androids will work until the conditions destroy them.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Android on the Run
facts: A police manhunt flushed a fugitive android and a child out of a suburb; the android dashed across a busy freeway and escaped. {{CyberLife}} calls it an extremely rare malfunction.

media.title: Tech Addict: {{CyberLife}}'s Fortune Teller Computer
facts: {{CyberLife}} has built a quantum supercomputer to predict mass-extinction events.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.
